# Helio Start 2028 bounded proposal worksheet

**Purpose:** Reusable planning worksheet for a proposed 2028 Helio Start run. Complete and review this worksheet before any separate approval request. A completed worksheet is not an authorization.

  ____________________________________________________________________
- **Maximum admissions:** **25 admitted workspaces** (Customer Success staffing-capacity reference; planning limit only. Reconfirm capacity for the proposed run and dates.)
- Other proposed hard cap(s), such as spend or duration: ______________________
- Run closes at the earliest of these limits: _________________________________

## Owner and roles
- Accountable proposal owner: ____________________________________________
- Operating owner: _____________________________________________________
- Customer Success lead / coverage owner: __________________________________
- Measurement and reporting owner: _______________________________________
- Approval / budget owner(s): ____________________________________________
- Named after-hours backup and handoff: ___________________________________

## Proposed dates and observation windows
- Proposed start date: __________________  Proposed end / close date: __________
- Enrollment window and cutoff: __________________________________________
- Day-7 operating-read window: ___________________________________________
- Day-90 mature-outcome window and reporting date: _________________________
- Dependencies / date constraints: ________________________________________

## Budget and resourcing (proposal only)
- Requested budget and currency: _________________________________________
- Spend cap: __________________________  Funding source: __________________
- Budget owner: _______________________  Approval status: **Pending**
- Staffing assumption / capacity confirmation for these dates: _________________
  ____________________________________________________________________
- Any expected trade-offs with ordinary coverage: ____________________________

## Operating safeguards
Complete each item with the proposed control, owner, and evidence/check.

| Safeguard | Proposed control / threshold | Owner | Verification / evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Eligibility, admission, and assisted-routing boundaries | __________________ | ______ | __________________ |
| Unsupported-case prevention and escalation | __________________________ | ______ | __________________ |
| Paid-source attribution through final route (if applicable) | ______________ | ______ | __________________ |
| Stop / pause thresholds and decision owner | __________________________ | ______ | __________________ |
| Spend, admissions, and time-cap monitoring | _________________________ | ______ | __________________ |

| Outcome windows and denominator / exclusions | _______________________ | ______ | __________________ |
| Incident response and customer communications | ______________________ | ______ | __________________ |

**Customer Success coverage assumptions to confirm for this run:** staffed coverage Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Central; a named backup receives after-hours cases at the next service opening; account-level support minutes are measured continuously from first contact. Confirm or replace these assumptions before requesting approval.

**Evidence plan:** Report day-7 first supported integration as a leading operating indicator. Defer mature paid-active, refund-adjusted collected-cash, and account-level support-effort conclusions until every admitted workspace has its complete day-90 window. Keep pre-admission assistance separate from post-admission support, and state denominators and exclusions.

## Approval and sign-off
**Approval status: Pending**

| Decision / sign-off | Name | Decision / signature | Date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Proposal owner review | __________________ | __________________ | __________ |
| Customer Success capacity and operating review | __________________ | __________________ | __________ |
| Product / lifecycle / data safeguards review | __________________ | __________________ | __________ |
| Budget approval (separate approval required) | __________________ | __________________ | __________ |
| Explicit paid-traffic authorization (separate approval required, if applicable) | __________________ | __________________ | __________ |
| Explicit launch authorization (separate approval required) | __________________ | __________________ | __________ |

## Authorization boundary
The Customer Success capacity reference of **no more than 25 admitted workspaces** is a staffing-capacity limit, not approval to run a test. This worksheet, its completion, and any staffing-capacity confirmation **do not authorize paid traffic, a launch, a budget, production changes, or any change to eligibility or routing**. Paid traffic and launch each require their own separate, explicit approval. Until those approvals are granted, approval remains **Pending** and paid traffic and launch are not authorized.
